dispatch_jobs.reason: U2 jacket water temperature rising steadily ~2.5F/min since ~16:20 (161F to 185.5F, pre-alarm at 182F) while U1/U3 steady at 161F at the same load. Suspect real cooling loss (cooler fan/belt, coolant leak/low level, thermostat, possible freezing at 15F ambient). Need field verification of U2 cooling system and the jacket water temperature transmitter. U2 load reduced, and a controlled stop is planned if the temperature approaches the trip.
